scope: SECTIONSETTINGS nested source-object group-330 and destination-block group-331 output identity mapping.

source_context.model: DRW_Section::Settings stores nested DRW_SectionTypeSettings::m_sourceHandles and m_destinationBlockHandle; the legacy flat form stores DRW_Section::m_destinationBlockHandle.
source_context.documented_roles: Autodesk's Section Type Settings DXF table defines group 330 as repeated soft pointers to source objects, bounded by the source count, and group 331 as a soft pointer to the destination block object.
references: src/drw_objects.h: DRW_SectionTypeSettings and DRW_Section settings fields
src/drw_objects.cpp: DRW_Section::parseCode and parseDwg handle-list decode

implementation.behavior: Before emitting SECTIONSETTINGS bytes, resolve every nested source-object reference and destination-block link. A configured reference resolver supplies the final handle; otherwise source-handle remapping applies. The legacy flat destination-block group-331 field uses the same mapping. Source lists larger than the existing kMaxSectionSourceCount bound, NoHandle values, resolver exceptions, and zero/NoHandle results for nonzero source references refuse before record publication. A zero nested source entry remains a literal zero to preserve the existing counted list shape.
implementation.count_projection: Nested group 92 is emitted from the bounded source-handle vector size; source entries are no longer silently truncated to the maximum.
implementation.retry_behavior: Failure controls preserve the preexisting destination prefix; corrected output succeeds with a fresh writer because failed dxfRW writer state is sticky.

validation.input: Generated in-memory records only; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.

legacy flat destination group-331 remap and resolver paths
